description: Free. Get a NEAR Intents payment quote for one specific paid tool call, payable in any token NEAR Intents 1Click routes (e.g. nep141:wrap.near). Returns depositAddress and amountIn. Fund the deposit, then call the paid tool with the same arguments and params._meta["near-intents/deposit"] = depositAddress. One deposit pays for one successful call; failed calls do not consume it; a replay returns INTENTS_DEPOSIT_USED.

arguments.description: Exact arguments you will pass to that tool, e.g. {"q":"lofi"}.

originAsset.description: 1Click assetId you pay with, e.g. nep141:wrap.near. List: GET /v1/intents.

refundTo.description: Your NEAR Intents account (or origin-chain address with refundType ORIGIN_CHAIN) for refunds if the swap fails.

tool.description: Name of the paid tool to pay for, e.g. youtube_search.

name: near_intents_quote
title: ScrapeMole NEAR Intents quote (free)
